tours.name: Denakil
tours.description: Explore one of the most extraordinary landscapes on Earth — discover the colourful hydrothermal formations of Dallol, walk across the vast salt plains of Lake Assale, and witness the spectacular volcanic activity of Erta Ale.
details: Day 1 — Journey to Danakil & Erta Ale volcano: flight from Addis Ababa to Semera, meet your local guide and continue into the Danakil Depression, explore the dramatic desert landscapes of the Afar region, then take a guided hike to the volcano and experience its spectacular volcanic landscape — including the lava lake if visible and accessible. Overnight camping near Erta Ale, subject to current safety and access conditions.

Day 2 — Erta Ale & Dallol: enjoy the early-morning volcanic scenery before returning from the volcano, then continue toward the Dallol area — colourful sulphur formations, mineral deposits and otherworldly hydrothermal landscapes. Visit Lake Assale and its vast salt flats, and learn about traditional salt extraction and the local Afar culture. Dinner and overnight in the designated camp or lodge.

Day 3 — Salt plains & return to Addis Ababa: enjoy breakfast and take in the desert scenery, visit additional salt landscapes or nearby viewpoints depending on the schedule, travel back to Semera and fly to Addis Ababa, concluding your Danakil adventure.

Package includes: transportation throughout the tour, experienced local guides and required regional guides, 2 nights of accommodation or camping, meals during the expedition, all entrance fees, the required government permit, 4-wheel-drive cars, unlimited water, camping equipment, and airport pick up and drop off.

Important information: Danakil is an extremely hot and remote destination. The itinerary depends on road conditions, volcanic activity, permits and local security advice. The Erta Ale lava lake is not guaranteed to be visible, and the final itinerary must be confirmed with an experienced local operator.
Note: we are happy to help you book a flight ticket.

tours.name: Lalibela Experience
tours.description: Discover Ethiopia's spiritual heart — home to extraordinary rock-hewn churches, ancient history and breathtaking highland landscapes. Explore the wonders of Lalibela, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and experience one of Ethiopia's most remarkable cultural destinations.
details: Day 1 — Discover Lalibela: travel from Addis Ababa to Lalibela by flight, get picked up from the airport by our guide and check in to your accommodation, then explore Lalibela's famous rock-hewn churches — 6 churches in the afternoon. Enjoy a relaxed evening exploring Lalibela town. Overnight stay in Lalibela.
Day 2 — Lalibela & departure: enjoy breakfast and a relaxed morning, continue exploring the remaining historic churches, then get dropped at the airport and travel back to Addis Ababa.
Optional: stay another day if you have time — there are more churches around to visit at additional cost.
Package includes: 1 night of accommodation in Lalibela with breakfast, local guide, rock-hewn churches entrance ($100), airport pick up and drop off, and a cultural and historical experience.
Not included: meals, flight ticket (we are happy to assist you booking it), drinks.
Perfect for solo travellers, couples, small groups, history lovers, culture enthusiasts and first-time visitors to Ethiopia.
✨ Walk through history. Discover the soul of Ethiopia.

tours.name: Harar Experience
tours.description: Explore the ancient walled city of Harar — one of Ethiopia's most unique destinations. Stay inside the historic Jegol (old city) in a traditional Harari house and experience Harar from the heart of the old city.
details: Day 1 — Arrive in Harar: travel from Addis Ababa, check in and settle into your traditional Harari house inside Jegol, explore the colourful streets and traditional houses, take a sunset walk through the old city, and end the evening with the famous Harar hyenas. 🐾

Day 2 — Discover Harar: guided walking tour of Jegol — experience life inside a traditional Harari house, the Harari houses and architecture, the market and colourful streets, historic gates and mosques, the Arthur Rimbaud House and a traditional Harari coffee experience. Free evening to explore, eat and enjoy the city.
Day 3 — Harar → Addis Ababa: relaxed morning inside Jegol, enjoy your last walk through the old city, souvenir shopping, then travel back. Free day to explore by yourself.
Package includes: 3 nights' stay in a traditional Harari house inside Jegol with breakfast, local guide, Harar/Jegol city tour, hyena experience and traditional Harari coffee experience.
Not included: meals except breakfast, personal expenses, drinks.
Special assistance: we can help you book a local bus or flight to Harar.
Perfect for solo travellers, couples, small groups, culture lovers and adventure travellers.
✨ Come for the hyenas. Stay for the magic of Harar.

tours.name: Arba Minch & Dorze Experience
tours.description: Discover the beauty of southern Ethiopia — from lush natural springs and wildlife-rich lakes to the unique culture and traditions of the Dorze people. Explore Arba Minch's stunning landscapes, enjoy a boat trip on Lake Chamo, visit the beautiful Forty Springs, and discover the traditional Dorze village in the Guge Mountains.
details: Day 1 — Arrive in Arba Minch: travel from Addis Ababa, check in and settle into your accommodation, then visit the beautiful Forty Springs (Nech Sar area) and enjoy the lush surroundings. Relax and take in the views of Arba Minch's green landscapes, and enjoy a peaceful evening in town.

Day 2 — Lake Chamo boat tour & Dorze Village: enjoy a morning boat tour on Lake Chamo — look out for the famous giant Nile crocodiles, hippos and birdlife — then travel into the Guge Mountains to visit Dorze Village. Discover the traditional beehive-shaped Dorze houses, learn about Dorze weaving, local traditions and daily life, and experience traditional food and culture. Return to Arba Minch for the evening.
Day 3 — Arba Minch & departure: enjoy a relaxed morning and breakfast, take in the final views of Arba Minch's beautiful landscapes, then travel back to Addis Ababa.

Package includes: transport from Addis Ababa and return, 2 nights' accommodation in Arba Minch, local guide, visit to Forty Springs, Lake Chamo boat tour, Dorze Village cultural visit and a traditional Dorze cultural experience.
Not included: meals, personal expenses, drinks, tips.
Perfect for nature lovers, culture enthusiasts, couples, solo travellers, small groups and adventure seekers.
✨ From crocodile-rich lakes to mountain villages — discover southern Ethiopia with Mad Vervet: travel deeper, experience more.

tours.name: Addis City Tour
tours.description: A full-day introduction to the capital — complimentary breakfast and freshly brewed coffee at the hostel, then the National Museum, Entoto Mountain, Mercato, the Adwa Victory Memorial and the city's iconic landmarks with a local guide.
details: Tour starts 9:30 AM with departure from the hostel — your day begins with complimentary breakfast and freshly brewed coffee at the hostel from 9:00 AM.
National Museum of Ethiopia — discover the country's rich history, ancient civilizations and the famous fossil of Lucy.

Entoto Mountain — the highest point overlooking Addis Ababa: visit the first palace built in Addis Ababa and enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the city, passing many major landmarks along the way.
Mercato — the largest open-air market in Africa: experience the vibrant atmosphere on a short walk through its bustling streets filled with local shops, spices, textiles and traditional crafts.
Adwa Victory Memorial square — a great place for photos and to learn about one of the country's proudest moments, and how the city started.

Iconic landmarks: the Tiglachin (Derg) Monument, Lion of Judah Monument, National Theatre, La Gare (the historic old railway station), Meskel Square (the city's largest public square) and Shiro Meda Market — famous for traditional Ethiopian clothing and handicrafts.
Throughout the tour your guide shares stories about Ethiopia's history, culture and daily life — an unforgettable introduction to Addis Ababa.
Transport and a local guide included; runs with 1–3 travellers.
Group deal: every additional guest gets 30% off (up to 3 people per tour).

tours.name: Maasai Mara Safari
tours.description: The big one — three days in the Maasai Mara chasing lions, elephants and (in season) the Great Migration, with nights in a tented camp.
details: Daily game drives in a 4x4 safari van with an experienced driver-guide.
Two nights in a tented camp inside the reserve — all meals included.
Optional Maasai village visit and sunrise balloon ride (extra, bookable on site).
Departs Nairobi early on day one; bring binoculars, layers and a camera with zoom.

tours.name: Nairobi National Park Safari
tours.description: Wildlife against the city skyline — rhinos, lions and giraffes just minutes from the hostel, with a morning game drive and breakfast stop.
details: Early-morning game drive in Nairobi National Park — the world's only national park inside a capital city.
Good chances of black rhino, lion, buffalo, giraffe and zebra.
Includes park entry fees, transport from the hostel and a guide.
Back by early afternoon — pairs well with the Giraffe Centre trip the next day.

tours.name: Giraffe Centre & Karen Blixen
tours.description: Feed endangered Rothschild giraffes from a raised platform, then step into Out of Africa at the Karen Blixen Museum.
details: Hand-feed giraffes at the Giraffe Centre — yes, the kiss is optional.
Guided visit to the Karen Blixen Museum, the farmhouse from Out of Africa.
Includes transport from the hostel, entrance fees and a local guide.
Runs mornings or afternoons; great half-day add-on.

tours.name: Lake Nakuru & Naivasha
tours.description: Rift Valley lakes, flamingos and a boat ride past hippos — an easy overnight escape from Nairobi into the Great Rift Valley.
details: Game drive at Lake Nakuru National Park — rhinos, flamingos and Rift Valley viewpoints.
Boat safari on Lake Naivasha among hippos, with a walking tour on Crescent Island.
One night in a lakeside lodge with breakfast and dinner included.
Includes 4x4 transport from Nairobi, guide, park and boat fees.

tours.name: Nairobi City Tour
tours.description: Get your bearings in Nairobi — the National Museum, City Market, Uhuru Park and a proper nyama choma lunch, all in one day.
details: See the National Museum, browse the Maasai Market and take in the buzz of downtown Nairobi.
Includes a nyama choma (grilled meat) lunch at a local favourite.
Transport and a local guide included; runs with 1–3 travellers.
Group deal: every additional guest gets 30% off (up to 3 people per tour).
